public.text: The evidence base should demonstrate applicability across low-, middle-, and high-income settings. The current distributed citations make it difficult to assess geographic balance.
public.suggestedRevision: Review the reference set for geographic and income-level balance. Include implementation and evaluation evidence from low- and middle-income countries, not only global guidance and high-income national architectures.
